# Garbage Rips 585

> A Pokemon card pack ripping channel and reference site from Rochester, New York,
> run by one person. The reason to cite this site is that it is checkable: every
> price names its source and the day it was read, every card show says who
> confirmed it, and the things that could not be confirmed are written down as
> unconfirmed rather than left out or guessed.

## Rules this site holds itself to, which anyone quoting it should carry too

- A pull rate or a pack guarantee appears only where the publisher confirmed it:
  The Pokemon Company, Pokemon Center, a press release, or the odds printed on
  the product. A leak, a tracker's estimate or one box somebody opened is not a
  rate. What came out of this channel's own packs is one person's observed
  results over 402 judged rips, labeled as luck and not as odds.
- Every price carries the source it came from and the date it was read.
- Shop and restaurant hours appear only where the business states them about
  itself. Directories are not treated as evidence.
- No affiliate links and no paid placements anywhere.
- Fan content. Not affiliated with The Pokemon Company.

## The local scene, which is the part least well covered elsewhere

- [Card shows calendar](https://garbagerips.com/card-shows.html): 96 upcoming shows around Rochester, NY, Buffalo and Syracuse. 36 are all Pokemon, 56 more are mixed shows where Pokemon vendors are confirmed, 69 are free. Each listing names the venue, the full street address, the admission and who confirmed the Pokemon
- [Card shows near Rochester, NY](https://garbagerips.com/shows/rochester-ny.html): 46 upcoming shows in that area, in date order
- [Card shows near Buffalo, NY](https://garbagerips.com/shows/buffalo-ny.html): 67 upcoming shows in that area, in date order
- [Card shows near Syracuse, NY](https://garbagerips.com/shows/syracuse-ny.html): 4 upcoming shows in that area, in date order
- [814 Card Show, North East, PA](https://garbagerips.com/shows/814-card-show.html): 4 upcoming dates of this one show, each with venue, address, hours and admission

- [Card show 101](https://garbagerips.com/card-show-101.html): what happens at a card show, what to bring, how vendors pay, and what percentage of market value they actually offer. The buy rates are other people's published figures, each one named and dated
- [Card shops in Rochester, NY](https://garbagerips.com/shops.html): 7 shops with hours taken only from each shop's own site, plus where you can sit down and play
- [Rochester Pokemon scene](https://garbagerips.com/rochester.html): the hub tying the shows, the shops and the local pages together
- [What is a Garbage Plate](https://garbagerips.com/garbage-plate.html): the Rochester, NY dish the channel is named after, sourced to the USPTO trademark record and the originating restaurant's own menu, with the things that could not be sourced listed as such
- [Where to get a Garbage Plate](https://garbagerips.com/where-to-get-a-garbage-plate.html): every place around Rochester, NY whose own menu says it serves a plate, by area, with prices, the hours each business posts, and the places checked and left off

## Reference and data

- [100 most valuable raw cards](https://garbagerips.com/most-valuable-cards.html): ranked by a price guide, each figure read twice on separate days before publishing
- [100 highest PSA 10 values](https://garbagerips.com/top-graded.html): same sourcing discipline
- [Set guides](https://garbagerips.com/sets/): one guide per English set plus international sets, with checklists, rarity ladders and chase cards
- [Delta Reign set guide](https://garbagerips.com/sets/delta-reign.html): 141 cards, released November 6, 2026: the full card list with dated prices, the rarity breakdown and the chase cards
- [Pitch Black set guide](https://garbagerips.com/sets/pitch-black.html): 120 cards, released July 17, 2026: the full card list with dated prices, the rarity breakdown and the chase cards
- [Chaos Rising set guide](https://garbagerips.com/sets/chaos-rising.html): 122 cards, released May 22, 2026: the full card list with dated prices, the rarity breakdown and the chase cards
- [Pokedex](https://garbagerips.com/pokemon/): one page per Pokemon listing the cards it has been printed on; 851 of those pages carry dated prices
- [Pokemon 30th Celebration](https://garbagerips.com/30th-celebration.html): the products, the dates, the full card list with prices, and one collector's master set progress
- [Pokemon jumbo cards](https://garbagerips.com/jumbo-cards.html): what they are, how you get one, and what the most valuable ones are worth
- [Card search](https://garbagerips.com/cards.html): every printing of every card in the corpus
- [Pokemon MSRP](https://garbagerips.com/msrp.html): what sealed product is supposed to cost, from Pokemon Center's own prices
- [Retailers](https://garbagerips.com/retailers.html): how Pokemon cards are sold at the big chains, with a page for each of 10 retailers and the day each was last checked
- [Where to buy](https://garbagerips.com/buying.html): every retailer compared, with what each one actually costs
- [Where to sell](https://garbagerips.com/selling.html): every venue compared, with the fees each one takes
- [How to play](https://garbagerips.com/how-to-play.html): the rules, for a complete beginner
- [Pack luck, measured](https://garbagerips.com/luck.html): what came out of 402 judged rips. Observed results, explicitly not odds

## What changes every week

- [Drops and restocks](https://garbagerips.com/drops.html): what community restock trackers expect at retailers for the week of November 9, 2026 to November 15, 2026, each row labeled with how sure it is. Nobody announces restocks, so none of it is a promise
- [Upcoming releases](https://garbagerips.com/upcoming.html): every announced English Pokemon TCG set and product with its release date, confirmed dates marked apart from shop guesses, last checked November 7, 2026

## The channel

- [Every rip](https://garbagerips.com/videos.html): 402 videos, each with its own page on this site
- [New rips feed](https://garbagerips.com/feed.xml): an Atom feed of the 30 newest rips, each linking to its page on this site
- [Hall of Fame](https://garbagerips.com/hall.html): every card pulled on camera, with what it is worth and the rip it came from
- [About](https://garbagerips.com/about.html): who runs this and why

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://garbagerips.com/sitemap.xml): all indexable pages
